Shuffle alleles among individuals

Source: R/accessors.R
shuffle_genomes.Rd

At each locus, pools the 2n allele copies of the population and assigns them to individuals at random. Allele frequencies and the state of every allele are kept; associations between loci (linkage disequilibrium) and between the two alleles of a locus (departures from Hardy-Weinberg) are removed.

Usage

shuffle_genomes(alleles)

Arguments

alleles

genomes, an array rows x alleles x individuals (see genomes()).

Value

An array of the same shape.

Examples

model <- evomod_model(additive(loci = 5, traits = 2), mutation(0.01, 0.1), init_sd = 0.1)
pop <- evolve(model, drift(5), n = 20, seed = 1)
shuffled <- shuffle_genomes(genomes(pop))
